spike_plan.kill_if: Build cannot be made green offline, or fewer than 6 open rule requests survive the upstream-overlap check (then the card is K1/K8 or K2).
spike_plan.pass_if: Offline-capable install and build go green, per-test results are emitted, and at least 6 open, verified, not-yet-upstream rule requests can be named with issue URLs.
steps: In a throwaway networked Linux container, clone typescript-eslint at c688f4a5 and strip git history.
Run corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile, then the build, to see whether the offline toolchain can be made green; record the first failing step.
Run the existing packages/eslint-plugin rule tests on the base to confirm a per-test report exists (smoke test had none).
Pin the rule list: for each candidate open issue, check it is still open and not already shipped in the rule catalogue (136 rules, 64 type-aware). Keep only unshipped rules.
Write one minimal stub rule and one RuleTester invalid case per candidate to check that the harness runs the case and reports per-case results.
Check determinism by running the suite three times and comparing pass sets.

v1.summary: The typescript-eslint v8.72.0 base is real and MIT-licensed, and the grading shape (per-rule RuleTester suites) is sound, but the rule list is unverified (not found), 64 of 136 type-aware rules already ship upstream, and the smoke build is red with no per-test report. Not killed; the 60-minute spike must confirm an offline green build and at least 6 open, not-yet-upstream rule requests before the card can pass.
